title: Mental Health Explorer catalog
description: Shape of catalog/indicators.yaml, catalog/groups.yaml and catalog/topics.yaml. Codes come from the combined 2021-2024 NSDUH PUF codebook.

topics.description: Every topic in the topic_id enum, in display order

variable.description: A column of the NSDUH public use file

phrase_template.description: Text with {cohort} (e.g. 'teens ages 12–17'), {people} ('teens') and {level} (the level label) placeholders

label.description: Display wording for the topic; lives only in topics.yaml

id.description: Unique within a cohort; the same id in both cohorts means the same concept

phrase.description: Completes 'About 1 in 7 teens ...', e.g. 'had a major depressive episode in the past year'

no.description: Source codes counted as 0; everything else is missing

universe.description: Denominator restriction: each variable must take one of the listed codes, e.g. {YMDEYR: [1]}

years.description: Years the item was collected; checked against the data

codebook.description: Entry name in the PUF codebook (normally the source variable)

implies.description: Indicator ids in the same cohort that a yes on this indicator implies by definition (directly; chains follow), e.g. mde_severe implies mde_py. Nested pairs are left out of the associations.

source.description: One PUF variable, or several when a level is a combination of their codes

crosses_only.description: True when the group is only for two-way crosses, not a standalone breakdown

phrase.description: Population wording template for takeaways, e.g. '{level} {cohort}' -> 'female teens ages 12–17'

codes.description: Source codes for this level; with several source variables, each item is one code per source, in order

phrase.description: Replaces the group's phrase template for this level, e.g. '{cohort} in families earning less than $20,000'
